_comment: Fallback for 'digit-i18n apply --request-info-file'. The preferred method is DIGIT_USERNAME/DIGIT_PASSWORD in .env (apply logs in fresh itself) - use this file only if you'd rather not store credentials at all. Copy this to a real file (e.g. request-info.json) and fill it with a CURRENT authToken + userInfo, copied fresh from your browser's network tab right before running apply. NEVER commit this file, and never reuse an old one - session tokens expire.
